source: Dirkies d_furniture_bedroom_01..05 (Daddy Dirkie / Melos tiles), rev 2. 12 pieces/sheet x 5 = 60: 2-tile floor bed, 4-tile large floor bed, 2-tile wardrobe (each one piece with 4 facings), nightstand, 6 dressers, bookcase, wall bookcase.
